repositories_github_shape_check.name: repositories_github_shape_check
repositories_github_shape_check.value: "repositories"."source_control_provider" != 'github' OR ("repositories"."installation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "repositories"."github_repo_id" IS NOT NULL)

task_runs_sleep_check_due_idx.name: task_runs_sleep_check_due_idx
task_runs_sleep_check_due_idx.where: "task_runs"."status" IN ('running', 'idle') AND "task_runs"."machine_id" IS NOT NULL AND "task_runs"."sleep_at" IS NOT NULL AND "task_runs"."sleep_requested_at" IS NULL AND "task_runs"."snapshot_id" IS NULL AND "task_runs"."snapshot_requested_at" IS NULL AND "task_runs"."vendor" IN ('modal', 'daytona', 'e2b')

task_runs_sleep_check_stale_worker_idx.name: task_runs_sleep_check_stale_worker_idx
task_runs_sleep_check_stale_worker_idx.where: "task_runs"."status" IN ('running', 'idle') AND "task_runs"."machine_id" IS NOT NULL AND "task_runs"."worker_heartbeat_at" IS NOT NULL AND "task_runs"."sleep_requested_at" IS NULL AND "task_runs"."snapshot_id" IS NULL AND "task_runs"."snapshot_requested_at" IS NULL AND "task_runs"."vendor" IN ('modal', 'daytona', 'e2b')

task_runs_sleep_check_active_idx.name: task_runs_sleep_check_active_idx
task_runs_sleep_check_active_idx.where: "task_runs"."status" IN ('running', 'idle') AND "task_runs"."machine_id" IS NOT NULL AND "task_runs"."sleep_requested_at" IS NULL AND "task_runs"."snapshot_id" IS NULL AND "task_runs"."snapshot_requested_at" IS NULL AND "task_runs"."vendor" IN ('modal', 'daytona', 'e2b')

tasks_initiator_shape_check.name: tasks_initiator_shape_check
tasks_initiator_shape_check.value: ("tasks"."initiator_kind" = 'user' AND "tasks"."initiator_automation" IS NULL AND ("tasks"."initiator_user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "tasks"."actor_external_id" IS NOT NULL)) OR ("tasks"."initiator_kind" = 'automation' AND "tasks"."initiator_automation" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."initiator_user_id" IS NULL)

webhooks_status_exclusive.name: webhooks_status_exclusive
webhooks_status_exclusive.value:
(
        (succeeded_at IS NOT NULL)::int +
        (failed_at IS NOT NULL)::int +
        (ignored_at IS NOT NULL)::int
      ) <= 1
